title: I’m building a browser-based multiplayer date game set in Kochi — Nummade Kochi
author: Academic-Yesterday22
selftext:
Hey, I’ve been working on a browser-based multiplayer game called **Nummade Kochi**.

It’s a small stylized version of Kochi designed around two people exploring the city together. You can walk around Marine Drive, explore Fort Kochi, ride scooters and boats, visit cafés, go fishing, pick flowers, watch the sunset, take the metro, play a penalty shootout, and discover different little activities around the city.  
The focus is the shared multiplayer experience, explore Kochi together, do activities, and just hang out. It also has **real-time voice chat** and text chat between the two players. It’s still an early build, and this is the first public test.

**Play Nummade Kochi:** \[[https://nummade-kochi.vercel.app/](https://nummade-kochi.vercel.app/)\]

Would love to hear what you think of it.
